8025.title: Failed plugin candidates skip lifecycle cleanup
8025.rootCauseOneLine: Failed-candidate teardown invalidates the API without running registered dispose hooks, leaving plugin-created tasks alive.
8025.proposedFix: Share the existing LIFO, per-hook error-isolated cleanup runner between normal disposal and failed-candidate discard; run it before database closure and handle invalidation.
8025.caveats: Timer and cleanup behavior reproduced twice; subscriptions, historical diagnostic-file counts, desktop freezes, and hung-service fallback were not dynamically tested. Full regression is inline in the HTML.
